purpose: Dedicated recursive fifteen-square full kernel, one operand evaluation per point, full-u64 semantics.
difference_from_product: Positive and negative point values are each evaluated once then squared; sign of each point square is nonnegative. It is not merely a product(a,a) wrapper.
domain: Positive equal self input; output2n, scratch>=10n, threshold>=56. Internal balanced helpers are used only for n>56; original full-domain helpers remain unchanged.
space: One evaluated operand m plus10m child work gives11m shared scratch; coefficient bank<=30m, thus41m<=10n for n>56, k=ceil(n/8). Actual slice-capacity obligations passed in whole-library development549/0; immutable gate pending.
termination: Same lexicographic actual call SCC ranks, child sizes k,h,m<n. Actual termination passed in whole-library development549/0; immutable gate pending.
analytic_cost: S(n)<=S(k)+S(h)+13S(k+1)+O(n). Fixed-arity analytic recurrence, not checked machine cost.
leaf: Previously verified dedicated Toom4 square at fixed leaf threshold24.
